metadata.title: A sharp threshold for a random version of Sperner's Theorem

nodes.name: Antichain and width of a poset
nodes.statement: An antichain in a poset $P$ is a collection of pairwise incomparable elements of $P$; the width $w(P)$ is the size of the largest antichain in $P$.

nodes.name: Boolean lattice and layers
nodes.statement: The Boolean lattice $\mathcal{P}(n)$ is the poset of all subsets of $[n]=\{1,\dots,n\}$ ordered by containment; its layers are $\binom{[n]}{k}$ for $0\leq k\leq n$.

nodes.name: Random subset $A_p$ and w.h.p.
nodes.statement: For a set $A$ and probability $p$, $A_p$ denotes a random subset including each element independently with probability $p$. A property holds w.h.p.\ if its probability tends to $1$ as $n\to\infty$.

nodes.name: Coarse and sharp threshold
nodes.statement: $p_0=p_0(n)$ is a coarse threshold for property $P$ if $p=\omega(p_0)$ implies $A_p$ has $P$ w.h.p., and $p=o(p_0)$ implies it does not. Sharp adds that for every $\varepsilon>0$, $p>(1+\varepsilon)p_0$ (resp.\ $p<(1-\varepsilon)p_0$) suffices.

nodes.name: Isolated set
nodes.statement: A set $v\in\binom{[n]}{\lceil n/2\rceil+1}$ is isolated if $v\in X=\mathcal{P}(n)_p$ but no subset of $v$ of size $\lceil n/2\rceil$ appears in $X$.

nodes.name: Nearly isolated set
nodes.statement: For $v\in\binom{[n]}{k}$ with $k\geq\lceil n/2\rceil$ (resp.\ $k\leq\lfloor n/2\rfloor$), $v$ is nearly isolated if $v\in X$ but at most one subset (resp.\ superset) of $v$ of size $k\mp 1$ is in $X$.

nodes.name: Closed set in bipartite graph
nodes.statement: Let $G$ be a bipartite graph with side $Y$. A set $A\subseteq Y$ is closed if there is no $A'\supsetneq A$ with $N(A')=N(A)$.

nodes.name: 2-linked set
nodes.statement: $A\subseteq Y$ is 2-linked if there is no $B\subsetneq A$ with $N(B)$ disjoint from $N(A\setminus B)$; equivalently, $A\cup N(A)$ induces a connected subgraph of $G$.

nodes.name: Middle two layers graph $M$
nodes.statement: $M$ is the bipartite graph with parts $L_k=\binom{[2k-1]}{k}$ and $L_{k-1}=\binom{[2k-1]}{k-1}$ and edges given by the containment relation.

nodes.name: $\ell$-chain
nodes.statement: An $\ell$-chain in a poset $P$ is a sequence $A_1\leq\cdots\leq A_\ell$ of $\ell$ elements of $P$. An antichain contains no $2$-chain.

nodes.name: Cost of a derived collection
nodes.statement: For $\mathcal{Y}=\{Y_A:A\in\mathcal{A}_t\}$, the cost is $\log_2|\mathcal{Y}|$. Conditional cost $\cost(Y|Z)=\log_2|\{Y_A:Z_A=Z\}|$.

nodes.name: $(\varepsilon,t,p)$-concentrated collection
nodes.statement: A collection $\mathcal{Y}$ of subsets of $V(M)$ is $(\varepsilon,t,p)$-concentrated if $||Y\cap X|-p|Y||\leq\varepsilon t$ for all $Y\in\mathcal{Y}$ with probability at least $1-\exp(-k/\varepsilon)$.

nodes.name: Weak and strong containers
nodes.statement: $(S',F')$ is a weak container for $A\in\mathcal{A}_t$ if $A\subseteq S'$, $F'\subseteq N(A)$, $|S'\setminus A|=O(t)$, $|N(A)\setminus F'|=O(t)$. A strong container additionally satisfies $|S|\leq|F|+o(t)$.

nodes.name: Lower and upper shadow
nodes.statement: $\partial_*A=\{v\setminus\{i\}:i\in v\in A\}$ is the lower shadow; $\partial^*A=\{v\cup\{i\}:i\notin v\in A\}$ is the upper shadow. $\partial A$ denotes whichever points toward the middle.

nodes.name: Closure $[A]$ and 2-linked component
nodes.statement: $[A]$ is the largest $A'\supseteq A$ with $\partial A=\partial A'$. A 2-linked component of $A$ is a maximal 2-linked subset of $A$.

nodes.name: Degree to a set $d(v,Y)$
nodes.statement: For a vertex $v$ and a set of vertices $Y$, $d(v,Y):=|N(v)\cap Y|$ is the degree of $v$ to $Y$.

nodes.name: Definition of $\mathcal{A}_t$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{A}_t=\{A\subseteq L_k:A\text{ is 2-linked},\;t=|N(A)|-|A|\geq |A|/2k\}$.

nodes.name: Main theorem: random Sperner threshold
nodes.statement: For every constant $p>3/4$, the largest antichain in $\mathcal{P}(n)_p$ is (one of) the middle layer(s), with high probability.
conclusions: Largest antichain in $X$ is contained in $\binom{[n]}{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$ or $\binom{[n]}{\lceil n/2\rceil}$ w.h.p.

nodes.name: Hitting-time theorem for $p>1/2$
nodes.statement: For every constant $p>1/2$, there exists $k\in\{\lfloor n/2\rfloor,\lceil n/2\rceil\}$ such that every largest antichain in $X=\mathcal{P}(n)_p$ consists of sets in $X\cap\binom{[n]}{k}$ together with nearly isolated sets in $\binom{[n]}{k\pm 1}$, w.h.p.
conclusions: Every largest antichain has the prescribed near-middle-layer + nearly isolated structure w.h.p.

nodes.name: Main technical theorem (two-layer expansion)
nodes.statement: Fix $\ell\in\{1,2\}$. Let $p>1-2^{-2/\ell}$ be constant and $X=V(M)_p$. There exists $c>0$ such that with probability $1-o(1/k)$, every closed, 2-linked $A\subseteq L_k$ with $\ell\leq|A|$ and $|N(A)|\geq(1+1/2k)|A|$ satisfies $|N(A)\cap X|-|A\cap X|\geq c(|N(A)|-|A|)$.

nodes.name: Kruskal-Katona-Lovasz lower-shadow bound
nodes.statement: Let $A\subseteq\binom{[n]}{k}$ have size $\binom{z}{k}$ for $z\geq k$. Then $|\partial_*A|\geq\binom{z}{k-1}$.
nodes.origin_citation: Kruskal 1963; Katona 1968; Lovasz, Combinatorial Problems and Exercises (Problem 13.31(b))

nodes.name: Three-consecutive-layers conjecture for $p=\omega(1/n)$
nodes.statement: For $p=\omega(1/n)$, the maximum antichains of $\mathcal{P}(n)_p$ are contained in three consecutive layers, with high probability.
conclusions: Every maximum antichain of $X$ is contained in three consecutive layers w.h.p.

nodes.name: Expansion lower bound (lem::iso)
nodes.statement: For $A\subseteq L_k$ with $|A|=a\geq 1$, $t:=|N(A)|-|A|\geq a\cdot\tfrac{1}{k}\log\tfrac{\binom{2k-1}{k}}{a}$.

nodes.name: Weak container lemma (lem::weak)
nodes.statement: There exists a global constant $K$ such that for every $\varepsilon>0$ and $k\geq k_0$ and $t\geq k\log^7 k$, there is a collection $\mathcal{W}_t'$ of pairs $(S',F')$ with $|\mathcal{W}_t'|\leq 2^{\varepsilon t}$ such that w.p.\ at least $1-\exp(-k/\varepsilon)$, every $A\in\mathcal{A}_t$ has some $(S',F')\in\mathcal{W}_t'$ that is a concentrated weak container with $|S'|\leq|F'|+Kt$.
conclusions: $\exists\mathcal{W}_t'$ of size $\leq 2^{\varepsilon t}$ of concentrated weak containers covering $\mathcal{A}_t$ w.p.\ $\geq 1-\exp(-k/\varepsilon)$

nodes.name: Strong container lemma (lem::strong)
nodes.statement: For every $\varepsilon>0$ and $k\geq k_0$ and $t\geq k\log^7 k$, there is a collection $\mathcal{W}_t$ of pairs $(S,F)$ with $|\mathcal{W}_t|\leq 2^{\varepsilon t}$ such that w.p.\ at least $1-\exp(-k/\varepsilon)$, every $A\in\mathcal{A}_t$ has some $(S,F)\in\mathcal{W}_t$ that is a concentrated strong container with $|S|\leq|F|+\varepsilon t$.
conclusions: $\exists\mathcal{W}_t$ of size $\leq 2^{\varepsilon t}$ of concentrated strong containers covering $\mathcal{A}_t$ w.p.\ $\geq 1-\exp(-k/\varepsilon)$

nodes.name: Cost facts (prop::costfacts)
nodes.statement: $\cost(Y,Z)\leq\cost(Z)+\max_Z\cost(Y|Z)$. If $Y$ is determined by $Z$ (surjection $f$ with $f(Z_A)=Y_A$), then $\cost(Y)\leq\cost(Z)$.
conclusions: Sub-additive bound and monotonicity under determination

nodes.name: Auto-concentration for tiny sets (prop::autoconc)
nodes.statement: If $\mathcal{Y}$ is a collection of subsets of $V(M)$ and $\max_{Y\in\mathcal{Y}}|Y|\leq\varepsilon t$, then $\mathcal{Y}$ is $(\varepsilon,t,p)$-concentrated for every $p$.

nodes.name: Union/difference concentration (prop::unionconc)
nodes.statement: If $\mathcal{Y},\mathcal{Z}$ are $(\varepsilon,t,p)$-concentrated, then disjoint unions $\{Y_A\cup Z_A\}$ and (when $Y_A\subseteq Z_A$) differences $\{Z_A\setminus Y_A\}$ are $(2\varepsilon,t,p)$-concentrated.

nodes.name: Chernoff-based concentration criterion (prop::Chern)
nodes.statement: If $\cost(Y)\leq\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{2p+1}\cdot\tfrac{t^2}{\max|Y|}$ and $\tfrac{5k}{\varepsilon}\leq\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{2p+1}\cdot\tfrac{t^2}{\max|Y|}$, then $\mathcal{Y}$ is $(\varepsilon,t,p)$-concentrated.
assumptions: Two stated bounds on $\cost(Y)$ and $5k/\varepsilon$ vs.\ $\varepsilon^2 t^2/((2p+1)\max|Y|)$

nodes.name: Expansion outside the middle (prop::expoutmid)
nodes.statement: For $A\subseteq\binom{[n]}{k}$ with $k\in[n]\setminus\{\lceil n/2\rceil,\lfloor n/2\rfloor\}$, $|\partial A|\geq(1+1/k)|A|$.

nodes.name: General-layer expansion theorem (lem::2-layers)
nodes.statement: Fix $\ell\in\{1,2\}$ and $p>1-2^{-2/\ell}$ constant. With high probability, for every $k\in[n]\setminus\{\lceil n/2\rceil,\lfloor n/2\rfloor\}$, every closed, 2-linked $A\subseteq\binom{[n]}{k}$ with $|A|\geq\ell$ satisfies $|\partial A\cap X|-|A\cap X|\geq c(|\partial A|-|A|)>0$.
conclusions: $|\partial A\cap X|-|A\cap X|\geq c(|\partial A|-|A|)>0$ for some constant $c>0$ w.h.p.

nodes.name: Tree-counting bound (lem::2-linked cost)
nodes.statement: Let $G$ be a graph with maximum degree at most $d$ and $v$ a vertex. The number of trees in $G$ rooted at $v$ with $a$ vertices is at most $(ed)^{a-1}$.
conclusions: Number of rooted trees of size $a$ at $v$ is $\leq(ed)^{a-1}$

nodes.name: Expansion for small $a$ (lem::iso-small-a)
nodes.statement: For $A\subseteq L_k$ with $|A|=a\leq k$, $|N(A)|\geq ka-\binom{a}{2}$.

nodes.name: Small-$A$ expansion in $X$ (lem::small a)
nodes.statement: For constant $\ell\in\mathbb{Z}^+$ and $p>1-2^{-2/\ell}$ constant with $X=V(M)_p$, w.p.\ $1-o(1/k)$, every closed, 2-linked $A\subseteq L_k$ with $\ell\leq|A|\leq\log^8 k$ satisfies $|N(A)\cap X|-|A\cap X|\geq c(|N(A)|-|A|)$.

nodes.name: Existence of good random subset $R$ (eqs (3)-(5))
nodes.statement: For every $A$, there exists a choice of $R\subseteq A$ with $|R|\leq 18 a\log^5 k/k^3$, $|L|\leq 18 t\log^5 k/k$, and $|G^h\setminus F'|\leq 9 t/k^{1/5}$.
conclusions: A random subset $R$ with the three size bounds exists

nodes.name: Existence of good $R'\subseteq T\setminus G$
nodes.statement: For every $A$, there exists $R'\subseteq T\setminus G$ with $|R'|\leq O(t\log^6 k/k)$ and $|D\setminus N(R')|\leq O(t)$.
conclusions: A random $R'$ with the two size bounds exists

nodes.name: Bound on $|S'\setminus A|,|G\setminus F'|,|A\setminus Q|$ (claim::A-Q)
nodes.statement: For every $A$, $|S'\setminus A|=O(t)$, $|G\setminus F'|=O(t)$, and $|A\setminus Q|=o(t/\log k)$.

nodes.name: Bound on $|H|$ (claim::H)
nodes.statement: For every $A$, $|H|\leq O(t/\psi)$, where $H$ is the minimum vertex set of $A$ such that $F''=F'\cup N(H)$ has $d(v,G\setminus F'')\leq\psi$ for all $v\in A$.

nodes.name: Bound on $|U|$ and $U\subseteq N(S'')$ (claim::U)
nodes.statement: For every $A$, $|U|\leq O(t/\psi)$ and $U\subseteq N(S'')$, where $U$ is the minimum vertex set of $\bar G$ such that $S=S''\setminus N(U)$ has $d(v,S)\leq\psi$ for all $v\in\bar G$.

nodes.name: Regularity used in strong-container proof
nodes.statement: The final step of the proof of Lemma~\ref{lem::strong} uses crucially that $M$ is regular; bi-regularity with degrees in $A$ larger than degrees in $N(A)$ would also suffice.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma~\ref{lem::iso}
nodes.statement: Write $|A|=\binom{2k-1-y}{k}$ and apply Theorem~\ref{thm::KK}; reduce to showing $f(y)\geq 0$ where $f(y)=\tfrac{y}{k-y}-\tfrac{1}{k}\log\tfrac{\binom{2k-1}{k}}{\binom{2k-1-y}{k}}$, then check $f(0)=0$ and $f'(y)\geq 0$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition~\ref{prop::unionconc}
nodes.statement: Triangle inequality on $|(Y_A\cup Z_A)\cap X|-p|Y_A\cup Z_A|$ for the disjoint case; analogous expansion for the difference case.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition~\ref{prop::Chern}
nodes.statement: Apply standard Chernoff bound to each $Y\in\mathcal{Y}$ with $|Y|\geq\varepsilon t$; union-bound using the cost hypothesis and the size hypothesis to get probability $\geq 1-\exp(-k/\varepsilon)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition~\ref{prop::expoutmid}
nodes.statement: Symmetry plus Theorem~\ref{thm::KK}: for $|A|=\binom{x}{k}$ and $k>\lceil n/2\rceil$, $|\partial_*A|\geq\tfrac{k}{x-k+1}|A|\geq\tfrac{k}{n-k+1}|A|\geq(1+1/k)|A|$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma~\ref{lem::2-layers}
nodes.statement: Reduce to Theorem~\ref{thm::2-layers} on $\binom{[2k-1]}{k}$ using Proposition~\ref{prop::expoutmid}, then take a union bound over $k$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm::main}
nodes.statement: Assume the conclusions of Theorem~\ref{thm::2-layers} and Lemma~\ref{lem::2-layers} hold for $\ell=1$. Push the highest non-empty layer down to the middle by applying the lemma to a 2-linked component, then handle the symmetric lower-layer case and the parity-of-$n$ closure-size dichotomy via Lemma~\ref{lem::iso}.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm::hit}
nodes.statement: Refine the proof of Theorem~\ref{thm::main} for $\ell=2$, treating 2-linked components of size $1$ separately and bounding nearly isolated sets by Markov; conclude that $B$ consists of $B_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$ and nearly isolated vertices in $\binom{[n]}{\lfloor n/2\rfloor\pm 1}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma~\ref{lem::small a}
nodes.statement: Bound $\cost(A)$ via Lemma~\ref{lem::2-linked cost} and Proposition~\ref{prop::costfacts}; use Lemma~\ref{lem::iso-small-a} and a Chernoff/union bound over $\ell\leq a\leq\log^8 k$ to obtain $|N(A)\cap X|-|A\cap X|\geq c(|N(A)|-|A|)$ w.p.\ $1-o(1/k)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma~\ref{lem::weak} (weak containers)
nodes.statement: Build intermediary sets $R,T,L,F',Q,R',Q',S'$ as in Figure~3, bounding cost and concentration at each step; conclude $(S',F')$ is a concentrated weak container at total cost $o(t)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma~\ref{lem::strong} (strong containers)
nodes.statement: Starting from a concentrated weak container $(S',F')$, define $H$ to fix high-degree-defect vertices, $F''=F'\cup N(H)$, $S''$, then $U$ and $S=S''\setminus N(U)$, $F=F''\cup\{v:d(v,S)>\psi\}$; verify concentration and edge-count bound to get $|S|\leq|F|+o(t)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm::2-layers}
nodes.statement: Combine Lemma~\ref{lem::small a} (small $a$) with Lemma~\ref{lem::strong} (large $t$), bound $\cost(A)$ via $A\setminus A^*$ and $A^*\setminus A$, and union-bound the bad event $|((S\setminus A)\cup(G\setminus F))\cap X|<\varepsilon^2 t/4$.

nodes.name: Reduce highest non-empty layer to $k\leq\lceil n/2\rceil$
nodes.statement: If $k>\lceil n/2\rceil$ for the highest layer $B_k$, apply Lemma~\ref{lem::2-layers} to a 2-linked component to construct a strictly larger antichain $(B\setminus B_k')\cup(\partial_* B_k'\cap X)$, contradicting maximality.

nodes.name: Symmetric lower-layer reduction
nodes.statement: An analogous argument forces the lowest non-empty layer of $B$ to be at $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$ or above.

nodes.name: Close out parity cases
nodes.statement: If $n$ is even, $B$ already lies in the middle layer. If $n$ is odd, by Theorem~\ref{thm::KK}, one of $[B_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}],[B_{\lceil n/2\rceil}]$ has size $\leq\tfrac{1}{2}\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$; apply Lemma~\ref{lem::iso} and Theorem~\ref{thm::2-layers} to conclude $B\subseteq$ one middle layer.

nodes.name: Bound number of nearly isolated sets
nodes.statement: Show that w.h.p.\ the number of nearly isolated sets in $X$ is at most $2^{n/2}$ via $\mathbb{E}[\#\text{nearly isolated}]\leq 2^{n/2}\cdot O(ne^{-\varepsilon n})$ and Markov's inequality.

nodes.name: Push highest non-empty layer down
nodes.statement: If $B_k$ has a 2-linked component of size $>1$ or a size-1 non-nearly-isolated component, swap it out using Lemma~\ref{lem::2-layers} to enlarge $B$. Hence $B_k$ for $k>\lceil n/2\rceil$ consists of nearly isolated sets only, so $|B_k|\leq 2^{n/2}$.

nodes.name: Forbid layer $k>\lceil n/2\rceil+1$
nodes.statement: Show $(B\setminus(B_k\cup B_{k-1}))\cup((\partial_*\partial_* B_k\cup\partial_* B_{k-1})\cap X)$ is larger than $B$ by analyzing two cases on the size of $|\partial_* B_k|\log n$ vs $|B_{k-1}|$, using Proposition~\ref{prop::expoutmid} and Lemma~\ref{lem::iso}.

nodes.name: Symmetric lower-layer bound
nodes.statement: By an analogous argument, the lowest layer of $B$ is at layer number at least $\lfloor n/2\rfloor-1$.

nodes.name: Close $n$-odd case
nodes.statement: For $n$ odd, WLOG $|[B_{\lceil n/2\rceil}]|\leq\tfrac{1}{2}\binom{n}{\lceil n/2\rceil}$ by Theorem~\ref{thm::KK}; the prior argument now applies for $k=\lceil n/2\rceil+1$ via Theorem~\ref{thm::2-layers}, forcing $B_{\lceil n/2\rceil+1}=\emptyset$ and $B_{\lceil n/2\rceil}$ to be nearly isolated.

nodes.name: Choose random $R\subseteq A$ with $q=6\log^5 k/k^3$
nodes.statement: Let $R=A_q$. Compute $\mathbb{E}|R|,\mathbb{E}|L|,\mathbb{E}|G^h\setminus F'|$ and apply Markov to get a deterministic $R$ satisfying~(3)--(5).

nodes.name: Bound $\cost(R)$ and concentration of $T$
nodes.statement: Use~(3) and Lemma~\ref{lem::iso} to get $\cost(R)=O(t\log^6 k/k^2)$. Bound $|T|\leq|R|k^3=O(a\log^5 k)$, then Proposition~\ref{prop::Chern} yields $T$ is concentrated.

nodes.name: Bound $\cost(F')$ via $\cost(L|R)$
nodes.statement: $\cost(L|R)=O(t\log^6 k/k)$, so $\cost(F')\leq\cost(R)+\max\cost(L|R)=O(t\log^6 k/k)$. Concentration of $F'$ follows from concentration of $T$ and $T\setminus F'$.

nodes.name: Construct $Q$, $R'$, $Q'$
nodes.statement: Define $Q=\{v:d(v,T)\geq k/2\}$ and $D=\{v\in Q\setminus A:d(v,T\setminus G)\geq k/4\}$. Choose random $R'=(T\setminus G)_{q'}$ with $q'=5\log k/k$ satisfying~(6)--(7); set $Q'=Q\setminus N(R')$.

nodes.name: Concentration of $Q'$
nodes.statement: Bound $\cost(R'|T)=O(t\log^7 k/k)$, so $Q\cap N(R')$ and hence $Q'$ are concentrated by Propositions~\ref{prop::Chern} and~\ref{prop::unionconc}.

nodes.name: Set $S'=Q'\cup A$ and prove Claim~\ref{claim::A-Q}
nodes.statement: Define auxiliary sets $G^\ell,A^\ell,G^{\ell\ell},A^{\ell\ell}$ and chain edge-count bounds via $|E(G,\bar A)|=tk$ to get $|S'\setminus A|=O(t)$, $|G\setminus F'|=O(t)$, $|A\setminus Q|=o(t/\log k)$.

nodes.name: Cost of $A\setminus Q'$ given $Q'$ via 2-linked tree
nodes.statement: Use that $A$ is 2-linked: if $A\cap Q'\neq\emptyset$, count rooted forests in $J$ rooted in $A\cap Q'$ via Lemma~\ref{lem::2-linked cost}; otherwise pick an arbitrary spanning tree, paying $\log_2|L_k|=O(k)=o(t)$ extra. Conclude $\cost(A\setminus Q'|Q')=o(t)$.

nodes.name: Define $H$ and prove $|H|=O(t/\psi)$
nodes.statement: Greedily build minimum $H\subseteq A$ with $F''=F'\cup N(H)$ satisfying $d(v,G\setminus F'')\leq\psi$ for all $v\in A$; obtain $|H|\leq|G\setminus F'|/\psi=O(t/\psi)$.

nodes.name: Concentration of $F''$
nodes.statement: Bound $\cost(H|S')=O(t\log k/\psi)=o(t)$, then Proposition~\ref{prop::Chern} gives $N(H)\setminus F'$ is concentrated; combine with concentration of $F'$ via Proposition~\ref{prop::unionconc}.

nodes.name: Define $S''$ and bound $|S''\setminus A|$
nodes.statement: Let $S''=\{v:d(v,F'')\geq k-\psi\}$. Then $A\subseteq S''$ and $|S''\setminus A|\leq tk/(k-\psi)=O(t)$ by~(9), giving $|S'\triangle S''|=O(t)$ and concentration of $S''$.

nodes.name: Define $U$ and prove $|U|=O(t/\psi)$
nodes.statement: Greedily build minimum $U\subseteq\bar G$ such that $S=S''\setminus N(U)$ satisfies $d(v,S)\leq\psi$ for all $v\in\bar G$. Then $|U|\leq|S''\setminus A|/\psi=O(t/\psi)$ and $U\subseteq N(S'')$.

nodes.name: Concentration of $S$
nodes.statement: Bound $\cost(U|S'')=O(t\log k/\psi)=o(t)$, then $S''\cap N(U)\subseteq S''\setminus A$ has $|\cdot|=O(t)$, giving concentration of $S''\cap N(U)$ via Proposition~\ref{prop::Chern} and $S$ via Proposition~\ref{prop::unionconc}.

nodes.name: Define $F$ and prove $|S|\leq|F|+o(t)$
nodes.statement: Set $F=F''\cup\{v:d(v,S)>\psi\}$. Edge-count $E(S,G)$ both ways via $|E(G,\bar A)|=tk$ to get $k|F|+(tk/(k-\psi))\psi\geq k|S|-(tk/(k-\psi))\psi$, hence $|S|\leq|F|+2t\psi/(k-\psi)=|F|+o(t)$.

nodes.name: Reduce to $a\geq\log^8 k$ and $t\geq k\log^7 k$
nodes.statement: Lemma~\ref{lem::small a} handles $a\leq\log^8 k$; for $a\leq k^3$, Theorem~\ref{thm::KK} with $a=\binom{k+\alpha}{k}$ gives $t\geq ak/4\geq k\log^7 k$; for $a\geq k^3$, the same conclusion follows from $t\geq a/2k$.

nodes.name: Apply concentrated strong containers
nodes.statement: Lemma~\ref{lem::strong} provides $\mathcal{W}_t$ of size $\leq 2^{\varepsilon t}$ such that w.p.\ $\geq 1-\exp(-2k/\varepsilon)$, every $A\in\mathcal{A}_t$ has $(S,F)\in\mathcal{W}_t$ with $|S|\leq|F|+\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{16}t$ and the two concentration bounds.

nodes.name: Easy case $|S|\leq|F|-\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{2}t$
nodes.statement: When $|S|\leq|F|-\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{2}t$, the inequality chain $|G\cap X|-|A\cap X|\geq|F\cap X|-|S\cap X|\geq p|F|-p|S|-\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{8}t\geq\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{8}t$ gives the conclusion.

nodes.name: Bound $\cost(A)$ via $A^*$
nodes.statement: Fix canonical $A^*$ for each $(S,F,a,g)$. Then $A\setminus A^*\subseteq S\setminus A^*$ and $A^*\setminus A$ is determined by $G^*\setminus G\subseteq G^*\setminus F$, so $\cost(A)\leq t'+\varepsilon t$ where $t'=t+(|S|-|F|)$.

nodes.name: Union bound on bad event
nodes.statement: Bound the probability that $|((S\setminus A)\cup(G\setminus F))\cap X|<\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}{4}t$ by $2^{-t'}\tfrac{\varepsilon^2 t}{4}e^{-\varepsilon t}$. Combined with $\cost(A)\leq t'+\varepsilon t$, take a union bound over all $A,a,g,t$ to conclude.
